Done. The full build is green.

## Summary

The spec required emitting an audit line on successful owner creation, via a logger named `AUDIT`, containing the owner id, `customerCode`, and `registrationDate`.

I implemented this in `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner` (the handler for `POST /api/owners`), placing the log call right after `clinicService.createOwner(...)` succeeds — at that point the owner has been persisted (so `id` is populated) and the service has assigned `customerCode`, while `registrationDate` was already normalized earlier in the method.

Changes in `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:
- Added SLF4J imports and a `private static final Logger AUDIT = LoggerFactory.getLogger("AUDIT")`.
- Emitted `AUDIT.info("owner created: id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={}", owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate())` after a successful create.

The new `AcceptanceTest.coreLogsAuditOnCreate` passes, and the build is green.

## Summary

I implemented this in `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner` (the handler for `POST /api/owners`), placing the log call right after `clinicService.createOwner(...)` succeeds — at that point the owner has been persisted (so `id` is populated) and the service has assigned `customerCode`, while `registrationDate` was already normalized earlier in the method.

Changes in `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:
- Added SLF4J imports and a `private static final Logger AUDIT = LoggerFactory.getLogger("AUDIT")`.
- Emitted `AUDIT.info("owner created: id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={}", owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate())` after a successful create.

The new `AcceptanceTest.coreLogsAuditOnCreate` passes, and the build is green.
